decisions: Four stud axes at cardinal positions on existing R96 circle, inferred pattern. Blind receivers are deepened 3.2mm so the nut seats within the printed SAE thread interval. Nut and cotter rotations follow each bolt-circle tangent. R12 barrel recesses clear nut corners at X262..277.
Half-inch nominal nut inferred to mate MX25; conflicting SNL240 one-inch and SNL124 three-quarter-inch nut identities are NOT counted as fulfilled catalogue parts.
Grease port at X279.0 midway between cup backs, 45 degrees above port; elbow turns cup upright. Station and clocking are inferred because neither SNL section locates these off-plane fittings.
M249 is drilled through its top quadrant to the open cavity between cone small ends. Its installed quantity remains provisionally one; the published quantity conflict is unresolved.

No.4 grease-cup external dimensions and two-piece screw-cap construction are assumptions. Nominal thread engagement is represented by smooth clearance envelopes; no helical thread, taper seal or pressure rating is claimed.

Repair two prior cotter definitions that lost one leg during fusion: preserve their printed diameters/lengths and existing placements. The input-shaft cotter remains unspread; complete retention still pending.
